{{Top}}
[[File:Naboo_throne.png|250px|thumb|The throne of Queen Amidala in her Naboo royal starship]]
{{Quote|You want me to stop calling you that? Then how 'bout you stop sitting up there on your throne and judging us peasants?''"<br />"''I don't have a throne anymore. The Empire ''blew it up''.|Han Solo and Leia Organa|<ref name="RFH">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>}}
A '''throne''' was a ceremonial chair used by a [[King/Legends|sovereign]], a high dignitary, or a similar figure of significant social status. While thrones were typically located in a formal audience room known as "throne room," royal [[Starship/Legends|starships]] would usually contain one as well&mdash;as was the case with the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian cruiser]] used by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="E1:IG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> The [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Imperial throne|throne]], up to his death during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], was a basic swivel-chair, owing to his more simple attire of a cloak.<ref name="complete locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

Most thrones were permanent, although some of them were mobile, allowing their users to move about while seated. Such mobile thrones included the [[Emperiax Walking Throne]]s<ref name="A&EG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> and the [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chairs]] used by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] of high rank.<ref name="NEGTW&T">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] had a throne cast from [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] installed aboard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Sword of Ieldis (starship)|''Sword of Ieldis'']].<ref name="KnightErrant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> Some thrones, such as the [[Neimoidian Throne]] [[monument]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], were towering structures.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

The pacifist [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] faction known as the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] constructed a throne for their [[Anti-Mandalore|leader]] located in their [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. It was known colloquially as the [[Throne of Mandalore]].<ref name="ShadowConspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>
